limitations: Native compiler calls operate on ambient state and require caller ABI/segment/TLS/stack invariants.
The compiler chooses the machine instruction after MOV SS; these APIs do not promise a coupled stack switch.
Ordinary NeverD memory MOV lifting remains split into scalar memory and selector effects; original-PC fault/restart equivalence is not certified by this bridge.
No code16, i386 CPU execution, other processors, CPL0..2 descriptor faults, alignment checking, asynchronous events or complete original GPR/flags restart state is certified by this native oracle.
Legacy task/segment dispatch, SMI/software SMM, SGX/AEX/EPCM, wider partial completion and device/controller ownership remain global gaps.
No LLVM release, production pin or LLVM gitlink change was made.
